lines.text: Jesus tells His disciples not to worry about what they will eat or wear, because life is more than food.
Jesus tells them to consider the doves, which have no storehouse or barn, yet God feeds them.
Jesus says the lilies do not labor or spin, yet not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one.
Jesus says the Father knows the disciples need these things, and tells them to seek His kingdom.
Jesus tells the disciples to sell their possessions and store an inexhaustible treasure in the temple, where no thief approaches.
